state.seed_assertion: A controller shall carry out a review to assess if processing is performed in accordance with the data protection impact assessment at least when there is a change of the risk represented by processing operations.

sentences.1: A DPIA is an ongoing process for managing risks, not a one-time exercise, and must be reevaluated when the risk represented by the processing operation changes.
sentences.2: You need to keep your DPIA under review.
sentences.3: You may need to repeat it if there is a substantial change to the nature, scope, context or purposes of your processing.
sentences.4: A new DPIA should be carried out if there is a change to the nature, scope, context or purposes of processing.
sentences.5: A DPIA is an ongoing process subject to regular review rather than a one-off exercise.
sentences.6: You should see it as an ongoing process that is subject to regular review.
